## Environment (19)

| variable | default | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HOOKRELAY_CONFIG` | `config.yaml` | Routing config: sources, sinks and rules |
| `HOOKRELAY_DB` | `hookrelay.db` | The ledger — every delivery, each attempt and the dead letters |
| `HOOKRELAY_PLUGINS` | `plugins` | Extra source and sink plugins, loaded at startup |
| `HOOKRELAY_ADMIN_TOKEN` | *(empty)* | Required for silence management; empty disables those endpoints entirely (403), so an unconfigured instance cannot be muted by a stranger |
| `HOOKRELAY_READ_TOKEN` | *(empty)* | Empty leaves /status open — single-operator dev mode |
| `HOOKRELAY_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `256 * 1024` | Inbound body cap |
| `HOOKRELAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `8` | Attempts per delivery before the row is dead-lettered |
| `HOOKRELAY_RETENTION_DAYS` | `14` | How long delivered rows are kept; 0 disables purging entirely |
| `HOOKRELAY_ALARM_URL` | *(empty)* | Self-alarm for dead letters (who watches the watchman) |
| `HOOKRELAY_ALARM_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `600` | Floor between two alarm sends, so a storm cannot page repeatedly |
| `HOOKRELAY_BREAKER_THRESHOLD` | `5` | Per-channel circuit breaker: consecutive failures before the channel is given a rest, and how long that rest lasts |
| `HOOKRELAY_BREAKER_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` | `60` | How long a tripped sink stays open before one probe attempt |
| `HOOKRELAY_ACTION_SECRET` | *(empty)* | Signs the buttons on a notification card and verifies them on the way back |
| `HOOKRELAY_ACTION_TTL_SECONDS` | `24 * 3600` | How long a card's buttons stay pressable |
| `HOOKRELAY_CARD_CALLBACK_SECRET` | *(empty)* | Optional second layer on /card-action: when set, the callback must ALSO carry the family's timestamped signature |
| `HOOKRELAY_WORKER_INTERVAL` | `1.0` | Delivery-loop tick, in seconds |
| `HOOKRELAY_PUBLIC_URL` | *(empty)* | Where a card's action LINK should point |
| `HOOKRELAY_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Address the server binds to |
| `HOOKRELAY_PORT` | `8100` | Port the server listens on |

## Routes (17)

| method | path | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | The operator board — every page this service serves hangs off it |
| GET | `/card-action` | Ask before doing |
| POST | `/card-action` | A human pressed a button on a notification card |
| GET | `/config` | Admin: the running config with secrets redacted |
| PUT | `/config` | Admin: replace the config after a dry parse — a config that cannot load never becomes the config |
| POST | `/config/reload` | Admin: re-read the config file from disk, same dry-parse rule as PUT |
| POST | `/deliveries/{delivery_id}/retry` | Admin: put one dead delivery back in the queue with a fresh attempt budget |
| POST | `/explain/{source_name}` | Dry run: what WOULD this payload do? Admin-gated because it reveals routing, and because the config page is its consumer |
| GET | `/healthz` | Liveness only — no dependencies consulted, so an unhealthy ledger cannot hide a live process |
| POST | `/hook/{source_name}` | The front door: one source's webhook, walked through the gate pipeline and routed |
| GET | `/live` | The ledger's wake-up line: one changed per write, a ping through the quiet |
| GET | `/metrics` | Prometheus text: events by door and outcome, deliveries, outbox, breaker state |
| POST | `/silences` | Admin: quiet one source for a window; every silenced event still lands in the ledger |
| DELETE | `/silences/{silence_id}` | Admin: lift a silence before its window ends |
| GET | `/status` | The board's data: recent events, deliveries, breaker and silence state as JSON |
| GET | `/topology` | The whole shape, from config alone — the read that belongs BEFORE a route change rather than after one |
| GET | `/trace/{event_id}` | One alert's whole journey: the original, where it fanned out to, and what each processing system sent back |
